engine_config.baseline: fresh Apache Solr 9.10.1 (wands_bench core, re-indexed same-run)

repetitions: 3 independent full-480-query runs for the record (plus 3 during development)
warmup: one full 480-query pass per engine, discarded

routing_split.punt_routed_share: 330/480 (68.75%), native NDCG10=0.666 vs solr=0.621 (native wins, but this is embedded-Tantivy-vs-remote-Solr on plain text, not a structural-retrieval comparison)
routing_split.structural_routed_share: 150/480 (31.25%, FastPath+Hybrid), native NDCG10=0.1192-0.1194 vs solr=0.1505 across repeated runs (native loses, ~-20.7% to -20.8% relative, stable)

headline_result.structural_routed_latency_ratio_range: 2.25x-2.90x (solr/native, varies with how warm the persistent Solr server already is; consistently clears the project's >=2x bar)
headline_result.decision_relevant_verdict: REVISE -- structural-routed traffic clears the latency bar but not the relevance bar; Phase 2's STOP-leaning relevance finding replicates on WANDS
